head: Dropseam: clothing mockup and tech pack app for iPhone and iPad
dek: Dropseam lets you design clothing mockups and illustrated tech packs on an iPhone or iPad, from a garment template with your own measurements and artwork. It came out on 25 November for $2.99 and was #29 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 27 November.
details: You can place several PNG or SVG artworks on the front, back or a fabric panel, save a size chart with size grading, and record sample measurements. It exports a PDF tech pack with dimensions, print placements and notes, or a ZIP for the factory with the original artwork. Drafts stay on the device. The maker, Gage Dunstan, says previews are illustrative, so fit and print placement should be checked on a real sample.
where: iPhone and iPad with iOS 15 or later; $2.99 on the App Store
means: If you're starting a small clothing or streetwear brand, you can prepare the files a factory asks for on your phone instead of a desktop design program.
todo: Check fit and print placement on a physical sample before you order production, as the listing advises.
